scientific_question: How much independently oriented ordinary-rank state is required to reproduce the terminal sparse-expert c_proj residual write in routed function space, and is that requirement compatible with 200--500x trainable-state compression?

theory_reconciliation.dense_precedent: The sealed dense-MLP c_proj residual analysis found that an equal-chart rank-38 oracle recovered only 0.0971, while 80% residual energy required rank about 476 and 0.679 of dense intrinsic degrees of freedom. That result bounds explicit low-rank/factor/basis state, not arbitrary procedural generators.
theory_reconciliation.feature_write_nonidentifiability: The two-seed heldout-neuron oracle rejected even a full-c_proj-size feature-to-write decoder: terminal c_fc features and their motion do not determine c_proj write orientation. Any viable c_proj map must own an independent output/error directional stream.
theory_reconciliation.full_rank_compact_controls: A learned 4,352-coordinate rank-two Kronecker image recovered about 0.334, and a 4,194-coordinate rank-nine MPO recovered about 0.358. The MPO may have full ordinary matrix rank, so the present low-rank bound does not subsume that failure; the two results must be interpreted jointly.
theory_reconciliation.joint_rank_bound: For fixed terminal routing and c_fc, a rank-r c_proj for each of E experts contributes a routed action matrix of rank at most r. Their sum has rank at most E*r even with perfect cross-expert cancellation. Therefore the best rank-(E*r) SVD of the exact joint routed write is an optimistic upper bound for every explicit per-expert rank-r parameterization.
theory_reconciliation.state_accounting: One expert c_proj is 768x1536. An arbitrary rank-r matrix has intrinsic dimension r(768+1536-r). At 200x the per-expert coordinate budget is floor(1179648/200)=5898 and admits rank 2; the 4,194-coordinate MPO budget and 500x admit only rank 1 as ordinary low-rank state.
theory_reconciliation.frame_stability: Leading output-space subspaces are compared across two discovery banks and one untouched bank. High overlap would favor a larger persistent output basis; low overlap would favor a task-conditioned nonpersistent online write mechanism.
theory_reconciliation.why_no_new_training_arm: This analysis selects an architecture class, not a candidate. A state-budget result cannot by itself justify another rank, radix, FHT, optimizer, learning-rate, generated-expert, or larger-rung run.

functional_protocol.score: Exact terminal c_proj minus exact reproducible step-zero c_proj, applied to terminal same-run routing and c_fc activations. The analysis observes spectra only and fits no coordinates.
functional_protocol.anti_leakage: All three token banks and sampled layers are frozen before spectrum values. The heldout bank is used only for descriptive stability and the preregistered all-bank gate; no candidate is fitted or selected.

scopes: joint routed action spectrum for an optimistic cross-expert upper bound
isolated expert routed action spectra for descriptive heterogeneity
joint output-subspace overlap across all token-bank pairs

decision_rule.pass: If both gates pass, explicit per-expert low-rank write state is not ruled out at 200x; only a separately preregistered causal rank-2 functional oracle may be considered.
decision_rule.fail: If either gate fails, explicit ordinary-low-rank c_proj state is incompatible with 200x on this terminal routed function. Reconcile the measured rank and subspace stability with the failed full-rank MPO before choosing among a relaxed c_proj compression target, a dense residual-write exception, or a nonpersistent task-conditioned write mechanism.
decision_rule.no_sweep: No rank, tensor, FHT, optimizer, learning-rate, seed, expert-count, or larger-model sweep is authorized.

scope_caveat: The joint-rank result is an optimistic necessary condition for explicit ordinary-low-rank per-expert matrices with fixed terminal routing and c_fc. It is not an information-theoretic lower bound for every nonlinear procedural generator, and isolated-expert spectra are descriptive because joint function may permit cancellation. The failed full-rank equal-budget MPO is independent evidence, not a consequence of this bound.
